description.value: Churchill Draughthouse is a cozy Victoria pub occupying a historic Government Street building whose roots trace back to the Garrick's Head Saloon of 1867, with its most colourful chapter being the rough-and-tumble Churchill Hotel of the 1940s–70s. The pub pours 20 rotating taps focused on BC and Pacific Northwest craft breweries, backed by a broad whiskey selection and West Coast pub-fare menu. It sits steps from Bastion Square in the heart of downtown Victoria, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists riding the inner harbour area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and rich. The Churchill is an active pub at 1140 Government St, Victoria, confirmed by both OSM and the website. The food menu explicitly labels items VG (vegan), V (vegetarian), and GF (gluten-free), confirming those dietary options. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. OSM opening hours differ from website hours — website preferred per rule 12.

Phone number (778.430.2250) is absent from OSM tags; sourced from website only.
